info.title: AgentOps Control Center API
info.description:
Instant messaging between two devices + AI-agent human-in-the-loop approvals.

WebSocket: `GET /ws/messages?ticket=<wsTicket>` — frames are `ClientEvent` (client→server) and `ServerEvent` (server→client); see components.

get.summary: List runs: operators see runs they created, reviewers see runs assigned to them.

post.summary: Start an agent run on an owned case (OPERATOR). Processing is asynchronous.

get.summary: Get a run (creator or assigned reviewer).
List approvals: reviewers see those assigned to them, operators those they requested.
Get an approval (assigned reviewer or requester).

post.summary: Approve or reject (assigned REVIEWER only). Atomic; a second decision gets 409.

get.summary: Audit events for runs the caller may see (creator or assigned reviewer), ascending.

post.summary: Log in with username/password. Sets the HttpOnly refresh cookie.
Revoke the refresh token and clear the cookie.
Exchange the refresh cookie for a new access token (rotates the cookie).

403.description: CSRF header missing or bad Origin

post.summary: Issue a short-lived, single-use WebSocket ticket.

get.summary: Get a case: owner OPERATOR, or a REVIEWER assigned to one of its runs.
Models exposed by the OpenAI-compatible server (`GET {LLM_BASE_URL}/models`). OPERATOR only.
Conversation between the caller and another user, ascending by id.

parameters.name: beforeId
parameters.description: Only messages with id < beforeId (pagination backwards)

get.summary: List all users (including the caller) with live online status.

ActionName.description: Whitelisted actions the agent may propose. Only these Rust functions can ever run.

AgentAnalysis.description: Validated analysis produced by the agent (API/DB representation, camelCase).

requiresApproval.description: Set by backend policy, not by the model.

ClientEvent.description: Every client → server frame. Discriminated by `type`.

ClientMessage.description:
Send a message. `expediteurId` / `dateEnvoi` are accepted for compatibility but ignored:
the server always uses the authenticated identity and its own clock.

reviewerId.description: Must be a REVIEWER different from the caller.

code.description: snake_case error code (unauthorized, forbidden, not_found, conflict, validation_error, ...)

InvoiceInput.description: Synthetic invoice data analysed by the agent.

RiskLevel.description: Risk level produced by the analysis.

RunStatus.description: Agent run lifecycle status (see the state machine in CONTRACT.md).

ServerEvent.description: Every server → client frame. Discriminated by `type`.

online.description: Live presence: true when the user holds at least one WebSocket connection.
